parameters.name: OpClass
parameters.description: Operating class of a channel that is in the non-occupancy list, from {{bibref|802.11ax|Table E-4}}.

parameters.name: Channel
parameters.description: Single channel number in the operating class on which the radar was detected.

parameters.name: Seconds
parameters.description: {{units}} remaining in the non-occupancy duration for the channel specified by the operating class and channel pair.

object.description: This object describes channels identified by Channel Availability Check (CAC) that may not be occupied.
